requirements.remainingWork: Unverified target, not production approval. Preserve the pinned measurement window and workload/failover/cost/recovery assumptions; measurement belongs to later runtime work.

requirements.summary: AWS reference and Kubernetes adaptation: Preserve that layout as the reference. Offer a separate Kubernetes adaptation using OCI images, two app pods, a separate job workload and managed backing services. Ingress/controller, image digest, resources, scaling limits and rollout policy need explicit selection.
requirements.remainingWork: The Kubernetes arrangement is a design alternative, not a reproduction of the AWS image or a measured sizing recommendation. See https://docs.mattermost.com/deployment-guide/server/kubernetes/deploy-k8s . Source decision status is preserved in the original factory; this new obligation records outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Workload and failover sizing: Measure peak active sockets, posts/second, recipients/post, attachment throughput and reconnect bursts; choose latency/error budgets and size remaining nodes for a replica outage. Retention, recovery targets and restore procedures remain open.
requirements.remainingWork: The reference proves that Jeeves can represent the architecture. It does not prove capacity or give complete production settings. Source decision status is preserved in the original factory; this new obligation records outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Backend implementation boundary remains a design: Template candidates: request validation, bounded persistence, job claims, live transport and file adapters. Application hooks: channel/post permission policy, thread rules, recipient selection and job-specific side effects. Choose transaction/retry/revocation guarantees explicitly.
requirements.remainingWork: No complete Mattermost clone or runtime is generated. Nested fixed shapes are supported; maps, unions, complete API import and state-machine authoring remain future work. See docs/reviews/mattermost-backend-review-2026-11-01.md. Source decision status is preserved in the original factory; this new obligation records outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: One logical server plus a separate same-codebase job process; AWS VMs/writer-reader/S3 and Kubernetes alternative are preserved source, not an editable deployment plan.
requirements.remainingWork: No Kubernetes, replicas, HA edition/licensing, probes, sizing or provisioning UI/runtime is provided. Preserve the source placements and outstanding operational decisions.
